warnings.message: Channel 'google_search' spend mostly follows the season or trend (62% of its movement), so it is hard to separate from seasonality.
Channel 'google_pmax' is active in only 9% of weeks; its estimate will be wide.
Channel 'google_display' is active in only 6% of weeks; its estimate will be wide.
7 channels and 5 controls is a lot for 108 weeks; expect wide intervals.

source.citation: Anderson, Anthony (2024). Multi-Region Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) Dataset for Several eCommerce Brands. figshare. Dataset.
